title: Trump says gas prices "will go down rapidly" when Iran war ends as Americans face rising costs
summary: CBS report (May 2026): gas hits $4.39, up $1.40 and nine straight weeks since the Iran war began, while Trump promises it will drop like a rock once the war ends.

assertions.quote: The gasoline, the oil will go down rapidly as soon as the war is over.
a $1.40 increase since the war with Iran began.
Gas prices are now at their highest point since mid-2022

verdicts.note: A 4.39 national average exceeds every reading since the summer of 2022, when gas peaked above 5 dollars.
The NSA gasoline index reached 396.961 in May 2026, above every month since July 2022 (396.952) and below only the June 2022 peak of 430.142.

May 2026 regular gasoline averaged 4.479, the highest monthly price since July 2022 (4.559); no month between Aug 2022 (3.975) and Feb 2026 exceeded 3.840 (Aug 2023), and the weekly 4.500 on 05/11/2026 was the highest since 07/18/2022 (4.490).

assertions.quote: before we get into the summer months when gas tends to get more expensive anyway.
